pages.text: Use the Experience Rod on an XP tank to withdraw experience. Sneak-use it to deposit yours. Select the quantity in its mode controls and try a small transfer first. Check the tank’s space when depositing.

The $(l:enderio:souls/vials)Void Vial$(/l) stores experience in your inventory. For a larger workshop setup, move liquid XP between the $(l:enderio:souls/xp)XP Obelisk$(/l), an XP Vacuum and a Fluid Tank.
